title: Overlay suites/<id>/trace.yaml
description: Optional machine trace from an adopter-minted leaf id to a case. function_id is a free string (unique as a leaf identity in the repo), not a required FR/REQ/IEEE code.

function_id.description: Adopter-minted leaf id. Non-empty, stable, no whitespace. Unique in the repo as one leaf; reuse the same string across levels. Not a required FR/REQ/LOGIN-01 pattern.

case_id.description: Adopter-minted case key. Need not follow a product numbering series.

type.description: Test technique, not a competing id.

level.description: Optional facet. Not a second id series.

span.description: local = one leaf; interaction = two+ leaves; system = an invariant. Not a second id.

relates.description: Other function_id values this case also exercises. Same id grammar; not a CROSS-01 series.
